Is it illegal to write a fictional story involving the rape of a child? I'm being serious and not looking for judgment.

In the US there are 9 restrictions to free speech. The rape of a child would fall under the obscenity and child pornography restrictions, unless, like the book The Kite Runner, the rape was used to advance the literary, artistic, political, or scientific value of the story itself. In this case it was used to advance the social, political and cultural ideologies in the book, and advanced the literary and cultural value of the actual book (as @chags has pointed out).

So as long as you're not writing and publishing stories glorifying the rape of children, and the rape itself is used to bring to light certain issues in the world with a focus on making people aware of said issues/putting and end to those issues, you are not doing anything illegal.

The rapes are bad enough, but the fact that this is a true story made it a very hard read. I don't actually recommend reading the book, because while it's extremely informative and written well, it's also the kind of book that makes you lose some faith in humanity.
